verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Grok models available through Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry (Azure), with Foundry offering Entra ID auth and an OpenAI-compatible API. Community posts independently confirm Grok is used via OpenRouter. Missing for 10: any evidence of AWS Bedrock availability, documentation of model parity (same models and versions) across these channels, and first-party documentation of OpenRouter-class gateway support.

support.subject: As a founder, I can consume the same models through major clouds or gateways — Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class routers — not only the vendor's own endpoint

citations.quote: Access xAI's Grok models through Google Cloud's managed platform with enterprise security, governance, and unified billing.
Grok models on Foundry give you strong reasoning, native tool use, enterprise authentication through Microsoft Entra ID, Azure-native monitoring, and an OpenAI-compatible API.
Grok has an order of magnitude less OpenRouter usage than Claude, GPT, even Gemini
